title: Interstellar
synopsis: A dying Earth, a wormhole, a daughter you leave behind, and a love that turns out to be a coordinate.

nodes.text: A harvest is failing and a bookshelf is dropping books in patterns. The road still runs toward Coordinates. Its next turn depends on the difference between choosing “Investigate” and choosing “Brush it off.” At Coordinates, the decision will matter as data as well as intent.

choices.consequence: You choose to investigate. By Coordinates, the decision has become data, precedent, and a problem larger than the person who made it.
You choose to brush it off. By Coordinates, the decision has become data, precedent, and a problem larger than the person who made it.

nodes.text: Murph's pattern points to a base nobody knew existed. NASA Underground comes either way; its meaning changes with the difference between “Drive there” and “Wait.” By NASA Underground, the system will have recorded that choice as precedent.

choices.consequence: You commit to drive there. It carries you toward NASA Underground, exchanging a familiar uncertainty for a consequence nobody has modeled.
You choose to wait. By NASA Underground, the decision has become data, precedent, and a problem larger than the person who made it.

nodes.text: Brand offers a seat on a mission to find humanity a home. Saying Goodbye is already waiting. What changes is whether “Take it” or “Refuse” is the instinct you carry into it. In NASA Underground, the rules change the moment you decide they can be tested.

choices.consequence: You commit to take it. It carries you toward Saying Goodbye, exchanging a familiar uncertainty for a consequence nobody has modeled.
You commit to refuse. It carries you toward Saying Goodbye, exchanging a familiar uncertainty for a consequence nobody has modeled.

nodes.text: Brand is alone on Edmunds' planet and nobody else is coming. The paths divide here: “Go” leads into Edmunds' Planet, while “Stay” makes By Her Bed the next reckoning. A third choice, “Take the third path,” keeps Stars in the Dorm in play.

choices.consequence: You go. The path to Edmunds' Planet opens, and the system registers the move before anyone admits the rules have changed.
You stay. The path to By Her Bed opens, and the system registers the move before anyone admits the rules have changed.
Some endings reveal themselves last. You take the third path. The path to Stars in the Dorm opens, and the system registers the move before anyone admits the rules have changed.

nodes.text: You land beside a small camp at the edge of a quiet sea. Brand walks out of the airlock with the dirt of a new world on her boots. The road into Edmunds' Planet began with “Go” in Steal a Ranger; here, that decision stops being a moment and becomes a life.

You sit with Murph until she sleeps and you hold her grandchild on your knee and you do not get up for a long time. The road into By Her Bed began with “Stay” in Steal a Ranger; here, that decision stops being a moment and becomes a life.

You take a janitor's job on Cooper Station and look up at the slow rotation of the wheel at night and you call yourself, finally, retired. The road into Stars in the Dorm began with “Take the third path” in Steal a Ranger; here, that decision stops being a moment and becomes a life.
